body.summary: vscode-plugin/src/chat/chat-panel.ts: outboxRows holds the rows from worker.onChange (undefined while the queue is off or unread); postOutbox(note?) projects them with projectOutbox for the shown chat (titles from deps.store, here = the row is this host's running queued message) and posts { type:'outbox', view }. It is called on every onChange, from postRestored (so every path that shows a chat — postInitialState on 'ready', new-chat, open-chat, the queue runner's showSession — posts the chat's outbox), and after a refused action with its note. handleMessage routes 'outbox-cancel' / 'outbox-dismiss' / 'outbox-resend' to outboxAction, which ignores a seq that is not a row of the shown chat (logged) and calls worker.act; 'outbox-retry-now' falls to the default (ignored until s4). Without deps.queue nothing is posted. Tests: five named tests in the new chat-queue-outbox-host.test.ts over real queue files and hosts (the resend test checks the attachment path reaches the CLI prompt; the rebuild test disposes the host mid-turn and builds a second over the same file with the same window key); the first also checks a switch posts the new chat's outbox at once with runningChat.here, and a no-queue host posts no outbox. Mutations: dropping the post from postRestored, dropping the refusal note, accepting another chat's seq, and here always false each fail a test. Plugin suite without force-exit: 1300 tests, 1290 pass, 8 skipped, 2 fail (pre-existing manifest-catalog). Typecheck clean.
